verdict.rationale: Steel offers multi-step browser workflows through its CLI (start session, navigate, click/fill, extract, stop) and programmatic Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium control. That lets engineers script repeatable sequences in their own code instead of relying on one-shot prompts. Workflow orchestration, though, is handed off to external frameworks such as AgentKit or CrewAI, and Steel documents no native workflow composition with loops, conditionals, or parameters. Missing for 10: a first-party workflow definition format, documented loop/conditional/parameter constructs, reusable parameterized templates, and independent corroboration.
